purpose: Ranked metadata schema plan following independent methylCIPHERv2 review. Proposal only; no canonical metadata changed.

catalog_scope.note: Do not describe all 147 internal catalog IDs as public accepted/requestable clocks.

migration_policy.legacy_fields: Keep existing fields and semantics. New nested fields are optional during migration; generate display aliases rather than immediately deleting established fields.
migration_policy.unknown_values: Use value=null with status=unknown when not found; use status=not_applicable only when the concept does not apply. Empty arrays mean known-none, never unknown.
migration_policy.evidence: Every new scientific claim should carry field-level source, locator, source date or snapshot hash, and evidence status. Upstream catalog values are discovery leads, not confirmed evidence.

confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.finding: Nine GrimAge2 proxy metadata records advertise postprocess=cox_to_years, but the respective model classes return the score unchanged; PAI-1 is the exception.
confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.classification: stale runtime metadata, not a numerical scoring defect
confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.plan: Correct declarations in the planned metadata pass and add a consistency check linking metadata transforms to model behavior.

confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.finding: Upstream methylCIPHER HypoClock declares an identity transform over mean beta, while pyaging returns 1 minus mean beta.
confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.plan: Review original paper and author code before deciding either implementation is incorrect; do not merge output semantics yet.

confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.finding: Feature-panel audit found 68 exact panel matches, 32 unavailable locally, four larger pyaging raw inputs due to normalization/background features; all 19 n_features differences are covariate or normalization terms.
confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.classification: resolved count semantics, with partial evidence limits
confirmed_metadata_issues_for_plan.plan: Retain distinct raw input, scoring panel, normalization panel, covariate, and effective model counts.

ranked_additions.semantics: Describe the raw input feature panel, transformed basis and effective serialized model terms separately. Counts must never silently substitute for one another.
ranked_additions.null_and_na: Set counts to null when not measured or not reported; dimension/basis status is unknown unless source establishes it. Use zero only for an explicitly empty/not-applicable panel.
ranked_additions.validation: Cross-check supplied feature names and counts against serialized artifacts and runtime preprocessing. If a model uses PCs, store raw CpG count and PC dimension separately. Retain legacy n_features as the existing effective implementation count until a deliberate versioned migration.
ranked_additions.ui: Show input CpGs/derived inputs and model dimension as separate labels; show normalization panel only when present.
ranked_additions.cost: Medium: metadata extraction plus schema/model-asset validators and compact catalog rendering.

ranked_additions.semantics: Separate author's described model requirements from pyaging's executable scoring contract; include direct and transitive derived-model inputs.
ranked_additions.null_and_na: An empty required_covariates or required_model_inputs list means verified no such requirements. Use null only when unknown. Distinguish a derived proxy dependency from a raw methylation feature.
ranked_additions.validation: Validate against implemented model class and `predict_age` dependency graph; make output construct/unit consistent with existing predicts/unit metadata. Record cohort-dependent transforms explicitly.
ranked_additions.ui: Provide a concise input/output summary and expand detailed steps. Expose covariate names and derived prerequisites before users run a clock.
ranked_additions.cost: Medium-high: multi-input models and runtime transforms require per-model extraction; no score change is required.

ranked_additions.semantics: Capture the fit/feature-selection dataset and participant descriptors with explicit distinction between methylation sample ages, outcome ages, and validation cohorts.
ranked_additions.null_and_na: Unreported descriptors are null/status unknown. not_applicable is allowed only where the clock has no relevant training cohort, such as a directly specified non-trained score.
ranked_additions.validation: Counts should be cohort-role-specific and must not sum overlapping datasets without an explicit participant-overlap note. Age fields state whether age belongs to assay sample or outcome label.
ranked_additions.ui: Show cohort and sample count first; put sex, ancestry, health status and age spans in expanded provenance details.
ranked_additions.cost: Medium-high: requires review against papers/supplements and field-specific evidence for up to 240 records.

ranked_additions.semantics: Separate platforms used in model fitting/feature selection from those supported, validated, or merely compatible at scoring time.
ranked_additions.null_and_na: Empty arrays mean none documented after review; use status unknown when compatibility was not assessed.
ranked_additions.validation: Training platforms must cite fit/feature selection; validation and compatibility must cite distinct evidence. Do not infer platform support solely from probe overlap.
ranked_additions.cost: Medium: controlled vocabulary already exists for platform; additional values and UI labels are needed.

ranked_additions.semantics: Keep scientific evidence, upstream source provenance, package authorship/copyright, model-weight license, redistribution permission, and author approval as separate concepts.
ranked_additions.null_and_na: Never convert a package license or a repository availability label into model redistribution permission or author approval. Unknown approval is not pending unless a request was actually sent.
ranked_additions.validation: Require direct license/permission evidence for legal claims. Keep package license outside per-clock model license.
ranked_additions.ui: Show only verified model license and approval labels; show not assessed where relevant rather than implying clearance.
ranked_additions.cost: Low-medium schema work; high review effort for third-party weights.

defer_or_keep.item: Do not replace `population` with training cohort text
defer_or_keep.reason: Population is a broad controlled summary; cohort identity and participant age/ancestry need separate structured fields.

defer_or_keep.item: Do not copy upstream codebook values wholesale
defer_or_keep.reason: Its `clock_meta_v1.csv` is joined without per-field provenance; unknown and not-applicable cells collapse to NA.

defer_or_keep.item: Do not equate upstream n_cpgs with pyaging n_features
defer_or_keep.reason: Upstream n_cpgs is a score-panel count; pyaging n_features counts its packaged implementation basis and can refer to transformed/nonzero terms.

defer_or_keep.item: Do not equate upstream `license` with author approval
defer_or_keep.reason: Mixed labels do not establish per-weight redistribution terms, package copyright, or author endorsement.

defer_or_keep.item: Do not call a matched biological construct identical implementation
defer_or_keep.reason: GrimAge v1 component IDs and pyaging GrimAge2 component records have distinct citation roles; a tensor audit supports shared fitted proxies, but not full-pipeline equivalence.

documentation_plan.change: Replace the standalone proteomic clocks documentation page with tutorial-linked guidance and per-clock notes.
documentation_plan.content: State prerequisites, units, transformation and status of input proxies; link to the relevant executable tutorial.

documentation_plan.change: Refresh discoverability of the existing tAge and tAgeMortality material in the bulk-RNA tutorial.
documentation_plan.content: The tutorial already contains executed examples; improve navigation and clearly state expected expression input, normalization, target/output scale, and cohort dependence without duplicating examples.
